rows.role_title: National President of the Bahujan Samaj Party
rows.text: The party's press note dated 01-09-2021, datelined 'लखनऊ, 01 सितम्बर 2021, दिन बुधवार' (Lucknow, Wednesday), says that 'बहुजन समाज पार्टी की राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष' (the National President of the Bahujan Samaj Party), former MP and former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, सुश्री मायावती (Ms Mayawati), continued 'आज भी' (today too) her meetings with senior office bearers of about ten divisions of Uttar Pradesh.
